purpose: Teach: 代物/承っ/施さ/組み立てる/忘れ物/目指せ/習う/参観

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品、なかなかの代物だな。
lines.en: This new product is quite impressive.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Steady opening on the assessment. Pause of approval before delivering judgment. The tone of a leader evaluating something solid.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。発注、承っております。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've taken the order.
lines.style: Respectful, efficient. Crisp delivery on the affirmation. Lean toward the task at hand—no elaboration needed. Composed and ready.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 手厚いケアを施さない顧客は、リピート率、低い。
lines.en: Customers who receive proper attention tend to come back. That matters.
lines.style: Deliberate pacing, slight weight on 'proper attention.' This is wisdom being offered, not mere direction. Calm authority. Watching for understanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトを組み立てる過程、丁寧に進めます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll move carefully through the project setup.
lines.style: Earnest and thorough. Slight emphasis on 'carefully'—he's taking this seriously. Confident but not rushed. Shows he's listened.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約書、忘れ物のないように。
lines.en: Make sure the contracts are complete. No oversights.
lines.style: Final-sounding but not harsh. Clear, specific instruction. Brief pause before 'no oversights'—this is the safety net. Expectation is clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。上場、目指せる業績、出ています。
lines.en: Yes. The results are already showing what we need for a listing.
lines.style: Slight lift of positivity. Measured confidence—not boasting, reporting facts. Touch of momentum in the delivery. Acknowledgment that things are tracking well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手、現場で習う姿勢、評価する。
lines.en: I respect how your younger staff learn by doing on the ground.
lines.style: Warm observation. Slight pause before the compliment lands. This is genuine recognition, not casual. Speaks to something he values. Reflective, not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。役員、現場参観、来週、設定します。
lines.en: I'll set up the executive site visit for next week.
lines.style: Efficient wrap-up. Direct and action-oriented. Small note of satisfaction—he's already planning ahead. Clean close, ready to move forward.
